Summary: Major upgrade adding milestone-based tasks, worker reputation, and more verification types.

- Added support for milestone-based tasks with partial payment release per milestone.
- Introduced worker reputation tracking and worker leaderboard/profile endpoints.
- Added new verification type: multi-witness.
- Introduced surge pricing (urgent/critical) with higher fees.
- Expanded API with new endpoints for task acceptance, milestone verification, and richer queries.
